data.readmeSummary:
## TikTok Profile Scraper

A TikTok profile scraping Actor that extracts comprehensive profile and post-level intelligence: public account metadata (bio text, verification status, follower/following counts), complete content history with per-post engagement metrics and timestamps, video technical specifications and direct media URLs, audio/song metadata, hashtags and collaboration information. Technical capabilities include batch processing of multiple profiles with automatic pagination, date-range filtering for temporal selection, support for custom data transformations, high-throughput extraction at scale, and structured export-ready datasets (JSON/CSV/Excel) for downstream analysis, modeling, and integration.

## Use cases

- Influencer discovery, vetting, and performance tracking for marketing campaigns  
- Talent scouting and creator recruitment with historical portfolio and growth metrics  
- Competitive intelligence and benchmarking of brand or competitor TikTok accounts  
- Lead generation and prospect research by extracting bio contact links and business details  
- Social media content research and audience analysis via complete video histories and engagement patterns  
- Brand safety and PR vetting through full-content reviews and collaboration histories  
- Data science and analytics: building training datasets, time-series follower/engagement models, and influencer scoring  
- E-commerce and UGC discovery: finding creators who promote products or act as sellers  
- Academic and social media research for longitudinal studies of creator behavior and platform dynamics
